shortDefinition.en: A physical lens property expressed in millimeters; it does not change when the lens is used with another sensor format.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 以毫米表示的镜头物理属性，换用其他传感器画幅不会改变它。

en: Equivalent focal length does not replace or re-mark the lens's actual focal length.
zh-cn: 等效焦距不会替代或改写镜头的实际焦距。

example.en: The XF16–50 remains a 16–50 mm lens while its manufacturer lists a 24–76 mm equivalent view.
example.zh-cn: XF16–50 厂商标注等效视角 24–76 mm，但实际焦距仍是 16–50 mm。

sources.title: XF16-50mmF2.8-4.8 R LM WR Specifications
sources.supports: The distinction between actual focal length and the stated full-frame equivalent.
